label: Practice fit
description: Share of evidence-bearing requirements whose category has approved knowledge coverage.

label: Evidence availability
description: Share of requirements with Strong or Moderate evidence after retrieval.

label: Deadline feasibility
description: Working days remaining against the requirement volume (8 requirements per working day baseline).

label: Compliance gaps
description: Inverse share of mandatory requirements that still need evidence.

label: Major unknowns
description: Inverse share of unanchored, unconfirmed or unresolved items.

label: Fee and contract constraints
description: Inverse share of fee and contract-term requirements that lack an approved position.
